messages.subject: Conversion from sequence to map file
parts:
Hi,

If I want to convert a sequence file(from output) to a map file, how
do I do it?

Saw a command called rhS2M() on one site to do this, but am not able
to execute it in Rhipe(using 0.65.4). Have u done away with it in the
latest version?

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Conversion from sequence to map file
parts:
Yes removed functions from later versions. To do this,

map = expression({
for( i in 1:length(map.values)) rhcollect( map.keys[[i]], map.values[[i]])
})

rhmr(map=map,ifolder,ofolder, inout=c("seq","map"))
